full_details: On the cold stage Garnish's roll had the nine in a fair hand. Kemp read the fair copy and said that what is set down he can no longer make up. You told him he might make something new, and that you would set that down at Easter, and that then you would have a long play. He promised three minutes of shin-scratching with a turnip if the cut stands. Burbage gave Alleyn's king to the empty galleries, liked what the house did with a voice, and asked for an English king whose crown burns his forehead, not the hunchback again, and not this week. Pope said the argument had run longer than the two cut lines. Kemp's exit cue is his cap, off on the ninth line. At night you struck one line of the Lent list, and left the rest.
one_sentence: You put nine of Kemp's lines into the book, cut two, and set his exit as his cap off on the ninth line.
title: Kemp's nine lines went into the book
